env GOFLAGS=-buildvcs=false
# Component properties retain static typing through imported GoX-only packages.
go mod edit -replace=github.com/alfu32/go-shared/gox=$GOROOT/gox
go run .
stdout '^counter:0$'
stdout '^counter:1$'
go vet .
go build -trimpath -o app$GOEXE .
exec ./app$GOEXE
stdout '^counter:1$'

# Wrong property types fail compilation before any component is mounted.
cp bad.txt main.gox
! go build .
stderr 'cannot use.*123.*string'

-- go.mod --
module example

go 1.26

require github.com/alfu32/go-shared/gox v0.0.0
-- main.gox --
package main
import("fmt";"example/ui";v "github.com/alfu32/go-shared/gox/goxview")
func main(){
 r:=v.NewRoot(nil,nil)
 if e:=r.Mount(<ui.Counter title="counter"/>);e!=nil{panic(e)}
 fmt.Println(r.Tree().Children[0].Text)
 r.Tree().Attrs[0].Value.(func())()
 if e:=r.Flush();e!=nil{panic(e)}
 fmt.Println(r.Tree().Children[0].Text)
}
-- ui/counter.gox --
package ui
component Counter(title string){
 n,set:=useState(0)
 ref:=useRef(0)
 ref.Current++
 return X"<button onClick={func(){set(n+1)}}>{F"{title}:{n}"}</button>"
}
-- bad.txt --
package main
import "example/ui"
func main(){_ = <ui.Counter title={123}/>}
